researcher.involvementNote: The person approved each stage's plan and preregistered rules before its runs (proposals from the agent) and set the compute; the agent proposed, implemented and selected every candidate by the preregistered rule. A web search was used only to look up the Canon paper's citation while porting; the candidates came from the model's knowledge of the literature.

research.computeNote: Metered by NextT-Gym over 37 runs (33 trained at least one update): platform GPU-hours, pod time x GPUs as the cluster recorded it (queueing excluded). Scales: S x4, C x13, M x16. LLM tokens and API cost: not metered. The base commit belongs to the private development history; the code bundle of every run, with its commit and SHA-256, is listed in bundles.json of the research evidence (traceUrl). Not included: the Stage 3 porting checks of 2026-11-03 (about 42.1 platform GPU-hours) and the bounded four-node check before the formal run.

closestPrior: Canon layers (Physics of Language Models, Part 4.1)
novelty.statement: Full Attention Residuals and Canon layers at all four positions in one model. Canon-A/C act on the input that each sublayer reads over depth, so the causal short convolution mixes neighbouring tokens of the depth mixture; Canon-B on q, k and v and Canon-D on the MLP hidden as in the Canon paper. Neither paper combines the two; the Canon paper does not use depth attention.
